## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] I ran `ruff check app tests` and `ruff format --check app tests` with zero errors.
- [ ] I ran the repository unit tests locally (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'`).
- [ ] I added or updated unit tests for behavior changed in this PR.
- [ ] I verified JSON-RPC contract compatibility for client-facing changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or interfaces changed.

## Change Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

List exact verification steps and their outcomes.
